name: Portugal
blurb: Atlantic surf, tiled facades, port wine and warm hospitality.
cities: Lisbon
Hilly streets, trams, pastel de nata and sunset viewpoints.
Porto
Riverside wine cellars and azulejo-covered churches.
Algarve
Golden cliffs, sea caves and surf beaches.
Sintra
Fairy-tale palaces in misty, forested hills near Lisbon.
Madeira
Levada walks, sea cliffs and flowers all year.
Azores
Volcanic crater lakes and whale watching.
Douro Valley
Terraced port-wine vineyards along a winding river.
Tomar
The Templars' Convent of Christ and its round church.
Elvas
Star-shaped forts and a long aqueduct on the Spanish border.

The birthplace of Portugal, with a castle and medieval streets.
Évora
A Roman temple, a bone chapel and a whitewashed Alentejo old town.
Pico Island Vineyards
Black lava-stone walls sheltering vineyards below Portugal's highest peak.
Alcobaça Monastery
A Cistercian abbey with the tragic lovers' tombs of Pedro and Inês.
Batalha Monastery
A Manueline Gothic monastery with unfinished chapels.
Côa Valley Rock Art
Open-air Ice Age engravings of horses and aurochs.

A giant Baroque palace-convent with a magnificent library.

A zigzag Baroque staircase climbing to a hilltop sanctuary above Braga.
University of Coimbra
A clifftop university with the gilded Joanina Library.
